name: StockFit API
description: StockFit is structured intelligence from SEC filings: normalized financials, institutional ownership flows, ETF exposure analysis, filing event timelines, and AI-classified business models. All sourced from official XBRL filings. Fully traceable to source documents. Updated daily. ## Start here: build an investment research view in 3 calls **1. Get the company profile** ```bash curl -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN" \ "https://api.stockfit.io/v1/api/company/details?symbol=AAPL" ``` ```javascript const profile = await fetch( "https://api.stockfit.io/v1/api/company/details?symbol=AAPL", { headers: { Authorization: "Bearer YOUR_TOKEN" } } ).then(r => r.json()); // { name: "Apple Inc.", sector: "Technology", fiscalYearEndMonth: 9, ... } ``` **2. Pull 3 years of financials** ```bash curl -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN" \ "https://api.stockfit.io/v1/api/financials/income-statement?symbol=AAPL&period=annual&limit=3" ``` ```javascript const financials = await fetch( "https://api.stockfit.io/v1/api/financials/income-statement?symbol=AAPL&period=annual&limit=3", { headers: { Authorization: "Bearer YOUR_TOKEN" } } ).then(r => r.json()); // [{ period: "2025-09-26", facts: { revenue: 416161000000, netIncome: 112010000000, ... } }, ...] ``` **3. See who owns it** ```bash curl -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN" \ "https://api.stockfit.io/v1/api/ownership/institutional-holders?symbol=AAPL&pageSize=5" ``` ```javascript const holders = await fetch( "https://api.stockfit.io/v1/api/ownership/institutional-holders?symbol=AAPL&pageSize=5", { headers: { Authorization: "Bearer YOUR_TOKEN" } } ).then(r => r.json()); // { data: [{ managerName: "BlackRock, Inc.", shares: 1157054556, pctOfShares: 7.87 }, ...] } ``` Financial structure. Ownership concentration. Decision-ready in seconds. Get your API token from the [StockFit dashboard](https://developer.stockfit.io). ## Go deeper The 3 calls above give you fundamentals. These give you the edge: - **Research summary** (`/api/company/research-summary`): profile + earnings snapshot + key metrics in one call (Starter, Stock, Pro) - **Economic model** (`/api/company/economic-model`): citation-verified business model: offerings, monetization, operating levers, moats, flywheels, failure modes (Stock, Pro) - **Ownership summary** (`/api/ownership/summary`): institutional concentration, top holders, beneficial owners, insider count (Pro) - **Fund exposure** (`/api/fund/reverse-lookup`): which ETFs and mutual funds hold this stock, sorted by position size (ETF, Pro) - **Filing timeline** (`/api/filings/timeline`): recent filings + predicted next filings + earnings date (Pro) ## What's inside - **Financials**: as-reported + normalized statements (annual, quarterly, TTM) with per-value SEC filing lineage, growth rates, sector-aware key metrics, Piotroski & Altman scores, chart-ready series - **Footnotes**: 17 structured datasets from the footnotes and schedules: revenue & business segmentation, per-tranche debt, credit facilities, leases, buybacks, pensions, concentration, workforce cost, and more - **Ownership & insiders**: institutional holders (13F) with history, beneficial owners (13D/G), insider transactions (Form 3/4/5), share classes, manager portfolios - **ETFs & mutual funds**: holdings (including daily), flows, overlap, composition, fees, performance, structural analysis, AI exposure models - **Earnings & dividends**: EPS history, snapshots, multi-year trends, quality metrics, calendars, upcoming earnings and dividends - **SEC filings**: search, 8-K event classification, section/item text extraction, S-1 offering pipeline, statistics, predicted filing calendar - **Company**: profiles, AI peer comparables, stock splits, IPO calendar, delistings - **Executives**: officers, compensation vs TSR, governance flags, company-selected KPIs (DEF 14A) - **Congress trades**: House and Senate STOCK Act disclosures by company, by member, and market-wide - **Prices**: delayed quotes and end-of-day close history, split-adjusted or unadjusted - **Symbols**: lookup, search, batch, and CIK/CUSIP/FIGI cross-referencing ## AI Integration (MCP) StockFit supports the [Model Context Protocol](https://modelcontextprotocol.io) with **OAuth 2.1** authentication. Sign in once in a browser, your AI client handles tokens automatically. No API keys to copy or rotate. Works with Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, ChatGPT, and any MCP-compatible client. ```json { "mcpServers": { "stockfit": { "type": "http", "url": "https://api.stockfit.io/mcp" } } } ``` Same config for everyone, no API key needed. Your client opens a browser the first time you connect, you sign in, and tokens refresh automatically after that. Full per-client setup (Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code): [developer.stockfit.io/mcp](https://developer.stockfit.io/mcp). ## What you can build |                                                            | | |---------|---| | **See what ETFs actually own under the hood** | Look through ETF holdings, detect overlap, and understand true exposure across funds. | | **Map institutional ownership in real time** | Track what top 13F filers own, how positions changed, and where capital is concentrating or exiting. | | **Track the IPO pipeline from filings, not headlines** | Monitor S-1 activity, offering terms, 8-K events, and predicted filing calendars directly from SEC data. | | **Compare any two companies side by side** | Pull normalized financials, peers, and ownership for AAPL vs MSFT in parallel. No joins needed. | | **Build LLM apps on structured SEC data** | Feed normalized financials, business models, and filing-derived insights into AI systems without preprocessing. | ## More use cases - **Predict earnings before they're announced.** Combine filing calendars, margin trends, and quality signals to anticipate earnings setups. - **Detect insider behavior that actually matters.** Flag executive-level buys, cluster activity, and unusual trading patterns. - **Run due diligence directly from filings.** Surface governance risks, ownership structures, and filing inconsistencies without manual parsing. ## Authentication All requests require a Bearer token passed in the `Authorization` header: ``` Authorization: Bearer your_token_here ``` Tokens are issued per account and tied to a subscription tier. You can manage your API tokens from the [StockFit dashboard](https://developer.stockfit.io). ## Rate Limiting Requests are rate-limited on two levels: | Limit | Window | How it works | |-------|--------|--------------| | **Per-minute** | Sliding 60-second window | Requests older than 60 seconds are dropped from the window continuously | | **Per-day** | Calendar day (resets at midnight UTC) | Hard daily cap that resets at 00:00 UTC | Every response includes rate limit headers: | Header | Description | |--------|-------------| | `X-RateLimit-Limit-Minute` | Your per-minute request limit | | `X-RateLimit-Remaining-Minute` | Requests remaining in the current minute window | | `X-RateLimit-Limit-Day` | Your daily request limit | | `X-RateLimit-Remaining-Day` | Requests remaining today (resets at midnight UTC) | When a rate limit is exceeded, the API returns HTTP `429 Too Many Requests`. Rate limits vary by subscription tier.
